title: harness-companion v2 config
description: Schema for .harness/config.json. capability_level is NOT a user field — it is computed by core at runtime (design Errata E1).

project_type.description: Project type. Used by init.sh detection; affects which verification commands are suggested.

verification_scope.description: Root-relative path constraining the workspace fingerprint scope (no-git path only). Default: entire project.

fingerprint_exclude.description: User-configurable glob patterns to exclude from workspace fingerprint. Built-in excludes (.harness/, feature_list.json) cannot be overridden (design §11.0).

commands.description: Verification commands. Empty array → no_checks (L1 docs-only project).

id.description: Stable command identifier. Lowercase letters, digits, dashes, underscores.

required_for_passing.description: If true, this command must pass for the feature to be eligible for passing. Optional commands execute but don't gate eligibility.

timeout_seconds.description: Per-command timeout in seconds. Default 300 (5 minutes).

applies_when.description: Optional predicate. The command runs iff any listed pattern matches an entry under the project root. If absent, command always applies. has_files entries are bash shell glob patterns relative to the project root (e.g. "package.json", "src/**/*.py", "*.lock"). Patterns without glob metacharacters (* ? [) match exact paths; patterns with metacharacters match any file the shell would expand them to.

command_origin.description: configured = user-defined; detected = scaffolded from project-type heuristics.

confirmation.description: Whether user has confirmed this command. configured→not_required, detected→pending until reviewed. Note: configured+pending and configured+rejected are INVALID combinations (see not.confirmation_combination).

allOf.description: configured+pending and configured+rejected are INVALID: configured commands don't go through a user review state; only detected commands use pending/confirmed/rejected to gate review.

not.description: Reject capability_level as a user field. capability_level is COMPUTED by core (design Errata E1).
